sections.title: Explanation
sections.content: In a statement the name usually comes first: *Anna a könyvtárban tanul.* In a question with *hol*, *hová*, *mikor* or *ki*, the question word comes first and the verb follows it immediately. The name goes after the verb: *Hol tanul Anna?*

sections.title: Nothing in between
sections.content: You know this pattern from *Hol van Anna?* Nothing stands between the question word and the verb, so *Hol Anna tanul?* is wrong.
With *te* or *én* nothing changes: *Hol tanulsz?* and *Mikor főzöl?* already have the verb right behind the question word.
